Kyiv has deployed a new laser weapon that shot down a Russian jet drone, and Russia reported the loss of a 13‑year-old soldier killed in combat. The United Nations Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine’s power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies.
